purpose: PULSE's eighth argument is ngspice's pulse count

oracle.derivation: ngspice-44.2 run of this deck; values match the closed form in the deck header.
oracle.command: ngspice-45 -b (meas tran find v(a) at the axis times); values are the closed form in the deck header

confirmed.derivation: ngspice-45 manual (ngspice.sourceforge.io/docs/ngspice-45-manual.pdf) 4.1.1: PULSE(V1 V2 TD TR TF PW PER NP), NP the number of pulses: rise 0 -> 1 over 1 ns (0.5 at 0.5 ns), 1 at 5 and 25 ns, and no third pulse at 40 ns, so 0 at 45, 50 and 95 ns. Xyce 7.10.0 has no NP (a third pulse at 45 ns).
